title: The buildable AI journey
promise: Move from first principles to specialist systems by producing, modifying, tuning, evaluating, and packaging real artifacts on hardware you control.

readiness.runnable-lab: A bounded local or browser exercise with an existing implementation.
readiness.guided-replay: A source-linked reconstruction of retained evidence; it does not claim a fresh run.
readiness.recipe-contract: A complete procedure whose expensive execution begins only as a fresh, budgeted experiment.

stages.title: Make a language model
stages.question: How does text become a prediction and a gradient?
stages.outcome: Trace the complete transformer learning loop, then change it without losing track of tensor shapes.

artifacts.title: Byte-level TinyGPT
artifacts.workload: light first; training duration is user-controlled
artifacts.summary: A readable ~0.8M-parameter transformer whose byte tokenizer, architecture, loss, and checkpoint format are all inspectable.

build.label: Train the tiny preset on the bundled corpus.

modify.label: Change layers, heads, width, or context in the source-of-truth model config.

tune.label: Change learning rate, batch size, seed, or step budget one variable at a time.

evaluate.label: Inspect initial loss, tiny-overfit behavior, samples, and tensor inventory.

package.label: Keep a validated .tinygpt checkpoint with its exact config and corpus.

artifacts.title: Browser-trained TinyGPT
artifacts.workload: runs in the browser; preset size controls cost
artifacts.summary: The same learning loop made visible through loss, sampling, presets, workers, WASM, and WebGPU-capable browser surfaces.

build.label: Open the playground and train a tiny model without a server.

modify.label: Replace the corpus or choose a different model preset.

tune.label: Adjust context, batch, learning rate, and generation controls in the lab.

evaluate.label: Watch loss and samples together; do not mistake lower loss for useful behavior.

package.label: Export the browser artifact and retain the settings that produced it.

stages.title: Make training trustworthy
stages.question: Is the learner correct before it is large?
stages.outcome: Use tiny-overfit, held-out loss, numerical checks, and bounded comparisons to separate implementation bugs from optimization problems.

artifacts.title: Tiny-overfit correctness receipt
artifacts.summary: A minimal proof that data loading, forward pass, backpropagation, optimizer state, sampling, and checkpoint reload agree.

build.label: Run the smallest overfit gate before any ordinary training run.

modify.label: Change only one of corpus, seed, precision, or optimizer settings.

tune.label: Use learning-rate and clipping changes only after gradients and expected initial loss are verified.

evaluate.label: Require memorization, checkpoint round-trip, and a sensible held-out comparison.

package.label: Retain the config, seed, loss trace, sample, and validated checkpoint as one receipt.

stages.title: Change model behavior
stages.question: Which intervention teaches the missing behavior with the least collateral damage?
stages.outcome: Turn data and an adaptation method into an adapter whose target gain and regressions are explicit.

artifacts.title: LoRA specialist adapter
artifacts.workload: fresh training requires an explicit budget
artifacts.summary: A narrow adapter built from a frozen base, traceable data, explicit LoRA geometry, and a held-out task gate.

build.label: Prepare supervised rows and run the retained SFT path against a frozen base.

modify.label: Change the target data or modules while keeping the baseline and holdout frozen.

tune.label: Vary rank, alpha, target modules, learning rate, or steps from the checked starting profiles.

evaluate.label: Compare target gain, breadth, safety, latency, RAM, and throughput to the unchanged base.

package.label: Bind adapter, base identity, prompt contract, recipe, and evidence into a specialist package.

artifacts.title: Distilled tool-calling specialist
artifacts.workload: replay is read-only; reproduction is a budgeted experiment
artifacts.summary: A real lineage where narrow file-operation depth reached 100% while breadth regressed, proving why routing is part of the artifact.

build.label: Reconstruct the student, teacher trajectories, filtering, and training lineage from retained evidence.

modify.label: Change teacher mix or selection slices as a new recipe version, never silently.

tune.label: Tune accepted rows, sampling mix, and steps against the same narrow and breadth gates.

evaluate.label: Read target and breadth scores together: 100% narrow depth did not make a general upgrade.

package.label: Package as routed-only with an explicit redirect boundary.

stages.title: Build the ruler
stages.question: Does the benchmark measure the capability it claims to measure?
stages.outcome: Freeze a baseline, validate the frontier ceiling, inspect slices, and end with a reproducible decision rather than a score screenshot.

artifacts.title: Needle 2 selection ruler
artifacts.workload: public evidence replay; rerunning model evaluation requires approval
artifacts.summary: A complete tiny-model journey from catalog ablation through a 2x2 distractor-and-safety training factorial, ending at a measured 45M capacity boundary.

build.label: Build the four training arms and verify the tiny-overfit correctness gate.

modify.label: Inspect how distractor-rich and safety examples differ while every other training variable stays fixed.

tune.label: Compare the four LoRA arms, three independent training seeds, and the predeclared unsafe-arm stop rule.

evaluate.label: Reproduce the public-dev decision and explain why sealed V2 and quantized parity stayed locked.

package.label: Retain fixtures, raw outputs, scorer, catalog policy, and conclusion as a benchmark artifact.

artifacts.title: Specialist factory report card
artifacts.workload: metadata lifecycle is light; model evaluation may require approval
artifacts.summary: A run directory that binds target, data, candidate, frozen evaluation, packaging evidence, resource measurements, and a terminal ship/retry/reject decision.

build.label: Create a factory run and populate its declared evidence contract.

modify.label: Version targets, gates, and policies without rewriting completed evidence.

tune.label: Change thresholds only before the candidate is scored, with rationale recorded.

evaluate.label: Run the same frozen evaluator on baseline and candidate, including regression slices.

package.label: Compile the complete run into a public before/after report and terminal decision.

stages.title: Make the model act
stages.question: What turns model output into a safe, useful local agent?
stages.outcome: Separate model capability, constrained output, validation, tool policy, state, and serving performance in one trace.

artifacts.title: Local tool-using agent
artifacts.workload: local inference; model size controls RAM and latency
artifacts.summary: An OpenAI-compatible local model server plus a multi-turn tool loop with schema validation and explicit execution policy.

build.label: Serve a local artifact, then run one bounded tool-using conversation.

modify.label: Change tool schemas, catalog routing, prompts, or execution policy independently.

tune.label: Tune decoding, prompt reuse, constraints, and routing before assuming more training is needed.

evaluate.label: Score call selection, arguments, legality, task completion, latency, and unsafe actions.

package.label: Ship the model, tool catalog, policy, and eval gate as one bounded system contract.

stages.title: Understand the machine
stages.question: Where do the time, memory traffic, and numerical drift actually come from?
stages.outcome: Use the readable implementation as an oracle while comparing kernels and architectures with end-to-end measurements.

artifacts.title: Kernel parity and speed receipt
artifacts.workload: read-only replay; fresh kernel loops require approval
artifacts.summary: A numerical and performance comparison that keeps reference math, optimized kernel, dispatch geometry, and end-to-end effect separate.

build.label: Trace reference attention and matmul before inspecting their optimized counterparts.

modify.label: Change precision, tile size, workgroup shape, or architecture one dimension at a time.

tune.label: Tune the measured bottleneck rather than optimizing a convenient microbenchmark.

evaluate.label: Require numerical parity, warmed timing, memory evidence, and end-to-end impact.

package.label: Retain source revision, device, shapes, precision, raw timings, and parity tolerance.

stages.title: Make it smaller and portable
stages.question: Did the artifact become cheaper to store, load, and run without losing its job?
stages.outcome: Distinguish file compression, RAM reduction, fewer operations, runtime kernel support, and retained capability.

artifacts.title: Validated MLX specialist package
artifacts.workload: conversion is bounded; validation loads the selected model
artifacts.summary: A model or adapter exported with identity, tensors, tokenizer, prompt contract, and evidence that the consumer can load it correctly.

build.label: Export a .tinygpt model, adapter, or Hugging Face directory into the MLX layout.

modify.label: Change the packaging boundary or consumer metadata without changing model claims.

tune.label: Choose quantization or pruning only against frozen quality, RAM, size, and speed gates.

evaluate.label: Verify round-trip load parity, file size, peak RAM, tok/s, and target quality.

package.label: Publish the bundle with model card, hashes, environment, limits, and decision.

stages.title: Cross runtime boundaries
stages.question: Which parts belong in Python, Swift and MLX, Core ML, WASM, or WebGPU?
stages.outcome: Choose a runtime from capability, ownership, memory, latency, energy, distribution, and browser constraints—not platform novelty.

artifacts.title: Parakeet browser ASR receipt
artifacts.workload: eight reference-scored LibriSpeech clips against native WhisperKit
artifacts.summary: A paired browser/native ASR lab: Parakeet wins bounded WER and latency while a frozen 50x short-clip throughput gate catches fixed dispatch cost.

build.label: Trace model download, cache, WebGPU load, audio preprocessing, and decoded transcript.

modify.label: Change audio input, caching policy, or runtime adapter while preserving the receipt schema.

tune.label: Tune chunking, preprocessing, and execution policy before changing model weights.

evaluate.label: Recompute paired WER, proper nouns, repetitions, per-clip RTFx, and the frozen decision.

package.label: Retain runtime versions, browser/device facts, cache state, input provenance, output, and limitations.

artifacts.title: Mac runtime boundary map
artifacts.summary: A comparison of owned MLX weights, Core ML deployment, Apple Foundation Models, and browser runtimes grounded in measured capability limits.

build.label: Map one use case across capability, context, RAM, energy, ownership, and distribution constraints.

modify.label: Add a new runtime only with a directly comparable evidence row.

tune.label: Tune routing and deployment policy; do not hide a capability gap behind serving changes.

evaluate.label: Use the same task gate plus latency, RAM, tok/s, energy, setup, and ownership constraints.

package.label: Record the chosen runtime, rejected alternatives, evidence, and reversal conditions.

stages.title: Look inside without fooling yourself
stages.question: Which internal representation causally contributes to a measured behavior?
stages.outcome: Turn a behavioral failure into a probe, control, intervention, and decision-changing prediction.

artifacts.title: Causal probe dossier
artifacts.workload: attach to a specific failure before running
artifacts.summary: A logit lens, linear probe, activation patch, causal trace, or sparse autoencoder investigation with negative controls and an intervention claim.

build.label: Start from frozen success and failure traces plus a falsifiable representation hypothesis.

modify.label: Change layer, token position, feature, or control while keeping the behavioral gate fixed.

tune.label: Tune probe or SAE settings on train data; reserve separate examples for the causal claim.

evaluate.label: Require random controls, replay stability, and a predicted behavior change under intervention.

package.label: Retain activations or hashes, probe weights, controls, intervention results, limitations, and recipe decision.
